name: Sur
title: Midianite tribal patriarch
summary: Sur was one of the five kings (or chiefs) of Midian who were killed by the Israelites after the incident at Peor. He was the father of Cozbi, the Midianite woman who was killed by Phinehas. His death was part of God's judgment against the Midianites for their role in leading Israel into idolatry and immorality.

keyEvents.title: Cozbi killed as a Midianite woman
keyEvents.description: Sur's daughter Cozbi was brought into the Israelite camp by Zimri, and Phinehas killed them both with a spear to stop the plague that struck Israel.

keyEvents.title: God's Command to Wage War Against Midian
keyEvents.description: After the incident at Peor, God commanded Moses to attack the Midianites who had led Israel into sin and idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Sur Is Killed in the War Against Midian
keyEvents.description: Sur was one of five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites in the war against Midian, along with Evi, Rekem, Hur, and Reba.

keyEvents.title: Sur Identified as a Midianite Prince
keyEvents.description: Sur is mentioned among the Midianite princes who were vassals under the Amorite king Sihon and were killed by Israel.

keyEvents.title: Sur's Daughter Identified After the Battle
keyEvents.description: After the victory over Midian, it was specifically noted that Kosbi was the daughter of Sur, a tribal chief in Midian, which underscored the seriousness of Midian's seduction of Israel.
